name: Orientation Courses in Dramatics
benefit: • **Training and Skill Enhancement:** The scheme provides orientation courses and workshops in various aspects of dramatics, including script writing, lyrics composition, direction, acting, stage setting, stage craft, background music, light effects, costumes, make-up, and the history of tiatr. These courses and workshops are intended to help tiatr artistes improve the standard and quality of tiat
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an individual. - The applicant must be interested in getting trained in various aspects of tiatr, including its song and music performances.
